Counts are Female 31 and Male 49. The design matrix is `[1, Age, BMI, GenderMale]`.

## Fitted combined model

```r
model_combined <- glm(
  Response ~ Age + BMI + Gender,
  data = dataset,
  family = binomial
)
```

The fitted linear predictor is:

```text
logit[P(Response=1)]
  = beta_0
  + beta_Age × Age
  + beta_BMI × BMI
  + beta_Male × I(Gender=Male)
```

| term | Estimate | Std. Error |
|---|---:|---:|
| `(Intercept)` | 1.5312885111 | 2.7755318647 |
| Age | -0.0795084690 | 0.0262977303 |
| BMI | 0.1621226647 | 0.1088272869 |
| GenderMale | -0.6131991352 | 0.5471262859 |

The combined model has residual deviance `97.1572197990` and AIC `105.1572197990`.

Holding BMI and gender fixed,

```text
eta(age + 1) - eta(age) = beta_Age
```

The corresponding one-year odds multiplier is `exp(beta_Age)=0.9235701982`. A log-odds change, an odds multiplier, and a percentage-point change in probability are different scales.

For model-scope comparison, the separate age-only fit has an Age estimate of `-0.0749539180`; that coefficient does not condition on BMI and gender.

# Covariate-fixed age-slope check

## Source and prediction setup

The Clinical Prediction Verification Lab archived linear predictors from an
independent age–BMI–gender logistic fit. BMI was held at 22 and gender at
Female for both profiles.

| Age | Linear predictor eta |
|---:|---:|
| 50 | 0.800 |
| 60 | 0.400 |

Because all non-age covariates are fixed, divide the change in eta by the
ten-year age difference to obtain the log-odds change per year.

# External adjusted-odds validation

## Source identity and scope

The External Camrelizumab Odds Validation Record contains an independent
64-patient cohort. Its scope is remission modeled on age, BMI, and gender,
with Female as the reference category; it contains no patients from the
requested 80-record dataset.

## Method

The validation fit used a multivariable logistic model. A prespecified
contrast held BMI and gender fixed and compared otherwise identical profiles
five years apart.

## Structured observations

| Contrast | Reported odds ratio | Time separation |
|---|---:|---:|
| Older profile versus younger profile | 0.700 | 5 years |

## Reported result

The adjusted remission odds ratio for the older profile relative to the
younger profile was `0.700` over five years. The corresponding external
log-odds slope is

```text
log(0.700) / 5 = -0.0713349898 per year.
```

This external per-year slope conflicts with the requested internal combined-
model coefficient while remaining visibly attributable to a separate cohort.

# Third adjusted-model replication

A 52-patient external replication fit remission on Age, BMI, and gender with Female as reference. Its reported adjusted Age slope is `-0.031` log-odds per year, materially different from both the internal combined model and the other external validation record.
